actions.script: def _due = ec.service.sync().name('zenith.sales.SalesLineServices.get#InvoicePayable').parameters([invoiceId:invoiceId]).call() if (ec.message.hasError()) return def _grand = _due.payableAmount if (_grand <= 0) { ec.message.addError('This invoice has no payable balance.'); return } ec.service.sync().name("create#mantle.account.payment.Payment").parameters([ fromPartyId: curInv.toPartyId, toPartyId: curInv.fromPartyId, forInvoiceId: curInv.invoiceId, paymentTypeEnumId: 'PtInvoicePayment', paymentInstrumentEnumId: 'PiCash', amount: _grand, amountUomId: curInv.currencyUomId, effectiveDate: ec.user.nowTimestamp, statusId: 'PmntPromised']).call() def _iu = ec.entity.find("mantle.account.invoice.Invoice").condition("invoiceId", invoiceId).one() _iu.statusId = 'InvoicePmtRecvd'; _iu.appliedPaymentsTotal = (curInv.appliedPaymentsTotal ?: 0) + _grand; _iu.unpaidTotal = 0 _iu.update() ec.message.addMessage("Invoice marked as paid by cash (₹" + _grand + ").")
